title: HELLO, WORLD
note: Printing program assembled with this project's M4 assembler. Lincoln Writer prints three lines of HELLO, WORLD.

title: Display and light-pen diagnostic
note: Draws four points on the CRT. Sequence 55 increments a counter when the light pen detects a bright point.

title: Sketchpad · 1963
note: Ivan Sutherland's original program, transcribed and reconstructed from CHM listings. Changes are recorded individually in manifest.json. Startup displays INK; aim the light pen at INK to begin tracking. The program selects devices absent from this machine. Startup automatically suppresses IOSAL, as shown in the console alarm panel.

title: Inchworm · 1958
kind: Historical program adapted for paper tape
note: H. Philip Peterson’s seven-word routine copies itself through core memory, then jumps back and starts again. The tape loads its original switch-register startup routine into T memory. No CRT output; watch P in the header.

title: HELLO · TX-2 Project example tape
note: Tape supplied by TX-2-simulator. After tx2tape fix relinks blocks and recomputes checksums, it boots through the original plugboard.
